title: Brajesh Kumar v. State of U.P.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Dilip Gupta, J.; Vinod Kumar Misra, J.
disposition: Writ dismissed; billing dispute relegated to clause 7.10.
headnote: A Division Bench of the Allahabad High Court dismissed a writ petition challenging electricity bills issued by Dakshinanchal Electric Distribution Corporation Ltd., Farrukhabad, holding that the consumer may raise a billing dispute under clause 7.10 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. The bills were not examined on merits.
facts: Brajesh Kumar petitioned the Allahabad High Court against electricity bills issued by the Executive Engineer of the Electricity Distribution Division of Dakshinanchal Electric Distribution Corporation Ltd., Farrukhabad. The State of Uttar Pradesh and two others were arrayed as respondents. Counsel for the respondents submitted that any dispute about the bills could be raised under clause 7.10 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. The Division Bench did not examine whether the bills were correctly issued.

holding_units.holding: A writ petition challenging electricity bills is not entertained where the consumer has a remedy to raise the billing dispute under clause 7.10 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005; the petition is dismissed on that alternate remedy.

not_decided.point: Correctness of the electricity bills issued by the Executive Engineer, Farrukhabad
not_decided.note: Writ declined without examining the bills; petitioner left to clause 7.10.
